interest: Shows Japan's 1942 bid for fuel-funded warship visits to Chile, and a 1940 Vichy-delayed cruiser request for Saigon.
overview: Docket sheets: Japan's 1942 agent Miyoshi offers fuel-for-warships deal to Chile, and a 1940 Japanese request for a cruiser's courtesy visit to Saigon, which Vichy France sought to postpone.

subfiles.about: Record of a War Department intelligence report concerning a Japanese offer to send warships to Chile in exchange for fuel oil to preserve Chilean neutrality.
subfiles.summary: Docket entry: agent Nozan Miyoshi offered Chile a fuel-for-warships deal, viewed as a bid to keep Chile neutral.
subfiles.title: List of papers entry on War Department report regarding proposed Japanese warship visit to Chile

subfiles.about: Record of a telegram from H. Freeman Matthews reporting on a Japanese request for a cruiser courtesy visit to French Indochina.
subfiles.summary: Docket entry: Japan requested a cruiser's courtesy visit to Saigon in late 1940; France asked that it be postponed.
subfiles.title: List of papers entry on Matthews telegram regarding requested Japanese cruiser visit to French Indochina
